capabilities: : Run AI analysis on text nodes (Sherlock/Maigret).
: Organize profile data into dedicated folders and notes.
: Compare datasets using Splink, Jina, or Combined.
: Embed and manage spreadsheet data within notes.
: Chat with AI about local or remote files and propose edits.
disambiguation: Not a general note-taking tool; it is specialized for public profile research and data correlation.
extras: Desktop only. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer. Requires specific Canvas plugins.
problem: Manually connecting and analyzing data points from various public profiles to identify a single individual is complex and time-consuming.
